short_bio: Swedish YouTuber Felix Kjellberg, whose channel was the most subscribed on YouTube for years.
biography:
Felix Kjellberg was born in Gothenburg, Sweden, and studied at Chalmers University of Technology before leaving to pursue YouTube. He started posting in 2010, mainly gameplay videos with running commentary, of games including Amnesia: The Dark Descent.

His channel became the most-subscribed on the platform in 2013 and stayed there until India’s T-Series overtook it in 2019. In 2017 Disney’s Maker Studios cut ties with him and YouTube dropped him from a premium programme after a Wall Street Journal report on jokes he had made in his videos.

He married Marzia Bisognin in 2019 and they later moved to Japan.
